title: Chapter 1353 - 27: Eighty Years Later (Part 3)
content:
Chapter 1353 - 27: Eighty Years Later (Part 3)

Chapter 1353: Chapter 27: Eighty Years Later (Part 3)

[Twenty years ago, when will I become an Entering Dao Master?]

[Thirty years ago, those old ministers in the court really deserve to die, don’t get angry, I’m the emperor now, I can’t get angry]

[Forty years ago, almost no one could tell if I was the real emperor]

[Fifty years ago, just now the master found me, asked me to take his place, and the master’s identity was actually the emperor of Da Feng, am I the emperor now?]

[Seventy years ago, if the master hadn’t found me, I, a beggar, would have probably frozen to death long ago, I must repay my master in the future]

...

The past moments of the puppet emperor, all presented in words before Lin Yuan.

Though certainly not the entirety, as this ability to view timelines is greatly suppressed.

But through these words, Lin Yuan roughly learned everything he wanted to know.

"As expected, a puppet emperor."

Lin Yuan’s expression was slightly heavy, "The real emperor of Da Feng disappeared fifty years ago, and the time they started cultivating the puppet emperor was seventy years ago, which is when I first arrived in this time-loop world."

A strange look appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

As soon as he arrived in this time-loop world, did they begin to cultivate a puppet?

Too much of a coincidence.

If the real emperor of Da Feng knew ahead of time that I wanted to kill him, and there was no way to stop it.

He should have started cultivating much earlier, why did it happen to be right when I arrived?

If the emperor of Da Feng learned of my intention to kill him at the very time of my arrival, even knowing there was no chance to resist.

He wouldn’t have immediately started training a puppet without any hesitation.

There might be an element of coincidence, but Lin Yuan still found it too coincidental.

"Unfortunately, I have no contact with this real emperor of Da Feng, so I cannot establish any crucial causal relationship to observe the other party’s timeline."

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

He could observe the puppet emperor’s timeline because he had killed him, creating important causality.

But the real emperor of Da Feng? He disappeared fifty years ago.

And fifty years ago, Lin Yuan, though he was above the average Entering Dao Master in strength.

He definitely didn’t have the strength to forcibly enter the palace of Da Feng.

Even knowing today’s scene back then, there was no way to establish any causal relationship.

Even now, Lin Yuan had to rely on Lin Dajun’s interference to successfully enter the palace.

"However, it’s not without gains."

"At least I know the real emperor of Da Feng is still alive, hiding somewhere in this world, I just need to find him."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Then stepped forward.

...

In front of the palace.

Many warriors and scholars were waiting patiently.

Until Lin Yuan’s figure appeared.

"Greetings, master."

Everyone immediately kneeled on one knee, respectfully toward Lin Yuan.

The more they reviewed this ’rebellion’, the more they realized Lin Yuan’s terrifying prowess.

Past dynasties perished due to weakness.

But the Da Feng dynasty perished at its peak.

The driving force behind everything was Lin Yuan.

With his efforts, he orchestrated across ninety-nine provinces, eventually pushing the Da Feng dynasty into the abyss step by step.

Even those who were close confidants of the ruler were in awe.

"Rise."

Lin Yuan glanced at the palace not far away and said casually.

He had already entered this palace, and had no curiosity about what was inside.

"The army entered the city, without disturbing the common people?"

Lin Yuan asked.

In this ’rebellion’, Lin Yuan’s target was only the emperor of Da Feng.

There was not much malice towards the people; in fact, he set rules to minimize the impact on the people during the invasion.

The small countries around Da Feng were basically infiltrated by Lin Yuan without committing any plundering against the people during such chaotic times.

"Reporting to the lord, the soldiers did not commit any offense."

The generals immediately responded.

Mainly because the battle went too smoothly.

.....

"Master, the Da Feng is in chaos, the master should establish a new dynasty and reunify the world."

One of the strategists immediately suggested.

This was inevitable.

Overthrowing the old dynasty and establishing a new one.

It was completely expected.

And necessary for the expansion of the turmoil.

"Hmm."

Lin Yuan nodded.

Now the real emperor of Da Feng is missing.

Lin Yuan still needs the power of the world to search for his whereabouts.

"I don’t know what to name the new dynasty..."

The strategist cautiously asked.

"Dynasty name?"

Lin Yuan thought for a moment, "Let’s call it Greater Yan."

On the third crossing, when Lin Yuan arrived in the world ruled by the Divine Weapon, he became the Prince of Greater Yan.

This time, establishing a new dynasty, Lin Yuan directly used the name Greater Yan to save the trouble of coming up with a new one.

"Greater Yan, good, let it be Greater Yan."

The generals exchanged glances, their expressions excited.

With the founding of Greater Yan, they would all become founding heroes.

Next.

Lin Yuan issued a series of orders.

To stabilize the situation in the newly established dynasty.

Not to mention that by the third crossing he already had experience in being an emperor.

Even within human civilizations, he had accumulated a wealth of lessons from ruling different dynasties.

Establishing a new dynasty, Lin Yuan was adept at it.

"And."

Lin Yuan looked at the generals and strategists, "Next, search for all people and things related to the remnants of Da Feng, I want to personally review all information and clues."

The purpose of this command was to find the real emperor of Da Feng, who disappeared fifty years ago.

Unless this real emperor of Da Feng retired into complete seclusion, otherwise, even hidden somewhere in the world, he would likely establish contact with the outside world.
